content.json:
# Privileged Access Changes

The Entra ID audit log, filtered to the changes an attacker makes to gain or keep privileged access
and that an administrator makes rarely enough to review: directory role assignments, new secrets and
permissions on applications, Conditional Access policy edits, security info (MFA method) changes and
password resets done by an administrator.

Every row names the **Actor** (who made the change). An actor you do not expect is the thing to look for.

**Tables read:** `AuditLogs`. A tile or chart for a table you do not collect shows an error; the rest still works.

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where Result =~ "success"
| summarize RoleChanges = countif(Category =~ "RoleManagement" and OperationName has "member"),
            AppCredentials = countif(OperationName has "Certificates and secrets management"
                                     or OperationName has "service principal credentials"),
            Grants = countif(OperationName in~ ("Consent to application", "Add app role assignment to service principal",
                                                "Add delegated permission grant")),
            PolicyChanges = countif(OperationName has "conditional access policy"),
            SecurityInfo = countif(OperationName has "security info"),
            AdminResets = countif(OperationName in~ ("Reset user password", "Reset password (by admin)"))
| project Tiles = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Role membership changes", "Value", RoleChanges),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Application credential changes", "Value", AppCredentials),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Consents and permission grants", "Value", Grants),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Conditional Access policy changes", "Value", PolicyChanges),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Security info (MFA method) changes", "Value", SecurityInfo),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Passwords reset by an administrator", "Value", AdminResets))
| mv-expand Tile = Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tile.Metric), Value = tolong(Tile.Value)
content.title: Privileged changes in the time range
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend Change = case(
    Category =~ "RoleManagement" and OperationName has "member", "Role membership",
    OperationName has "Certificates and secrets management" or OperationName has "service principal credentials", "Application credentials",
    OperationName in~ ("Consent to application", "Add app role assignment to service principal", "Add delegated permission grant"), "Consents and permissions",
    OperationName has "conditional access policy", "Conditional Access",
    OperationName has "security info", "Security info",
    OperationName in~ ("Reset user password", "Reset password (by admin)"), "Admin password resets",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Change)
| summarize Changes = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Change
content.title: Privileged changes over time, by type
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend Change = case(
    Category =~ "RoleManagement" and OperationName has "member", "Role membership",
    OperationName has "Certificates and secrets management" or OperationName has "service principal credentials", "Application credentials",
    OperationName in~ ("Consent to application", "Add app role assignment to service principal", "Add delegated permission grant"), "Consents and permissions",
    OperationName has "conditional access policy", "Conditional Access",
    OperationName in~ ("Reset user password", "Reset password (by admin)"), "Admin password resets",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Change)
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName), "unknown")
| summarize Changes = count(),
            Types = strcat_array(make_set(Change, 6), ", "),
            Addresses = strcat_array(make_set(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), 5), ", "),
            LastChange = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Actor
| top 50 by Changes desc
content.title: Who made privileged changes
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where Result =~ "failure"
| where Category in~ ("RoleManagement", "ApplicationManagement", "Policy")
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName), "unknown")
| summarize Attempts = count(), LastAttempt = max(TimeGenerated), Reason = take_any(ResultDescription)
            by Actor, Operation = OperationName
| top 50 by Attempts desc
content.title: Privileged operations that failed
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where LoggedByService =~ "Core Directory" and Category =~ "RoleManagement" and Result =~ "success"
| where OperationName has "member"
| mv-apply Property = TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties on (
    where tostring(Property.displayName) == "Role.DisplayName"
    | project Role = trim(@'"', coalesce(tostring(Property.newValue), tostring(Property.oldValue))))
| project TimeGenerated,
          Operation = OperationName,
          Role,
          Target = coalesce(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName), tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)),
          TargetType = tostring(TargetResources[0].type),
          Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)),
          ActorAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Directory role membership changes (direct)
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where LoggedByService =~ "PIM" and Category =~ "RoleManagement" and Result =~ "success"
| where OperationName has "completed"
| project TimeGenerated,
          Operation = OperationName,
          Role = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
          Target = coalesce(tostring(TargetResources[2].userPrincipalName), tostring(TargetResources[2].displayName)),
          Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)),
          Justification = ResultReason
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Role assignments and activations through Privileged Identity Management
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where LoggedByService =~ "PIM" and Category =~ "RoleManagement" and Result =~ "success"
| where OperationName has "completed" and OperationName has "Add"
| summarize Grants = count() by Role = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| top 15 by Grants desc
content.title: Roles granted most often

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where LoggedByService =~ "Core Directory" and Result =~ "success"
| where OperationName has "Certificates and secrets management"
    or OperationName has "service principal credentials"
    or OperationName in~ ("Consent to application", "Add app role assignment to service principal",
                          "Add delegated permission grant", "Add owner to application", "Add owner to service principal")
| project TimeGenerated,
          Operation = OperationName,
          Application = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
          Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)),
          ActorAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
          Changed = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Secrets, certificates and permissions added to applications
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where Category =~ "Policy" and Result =~ "success"
| where OperationName has "conditional access policy"
| project TimeGenerated,
          Operation = OperationName,
          Policy = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
          Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)),
          ActorAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Conditional Access policy changes

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where Result =~ "success"
| where OperationName has "security info" or OperationName in~ ("Reset user password", "Reset password (by admin)")
| project TimeGenerated,
          Operation = OperationName,
          Account = coalesce(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName), tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)),
          Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)),
          ActorAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250

content.json: These are the detection rules in this repository for this area (`Detection-rules/` in SentinelWork). A rule with 0 alerts is either not deployed, not enabled, or has had nothing to report in the time range. Alerts are matched to rules by name, so a rule you rename in Sentinel stops being counted here.

content.query:
let Rules = datatable(RuleId:string, AlertName:string, RuleSeverity:string, Tactics:string) [
    "PA-001", "Account added to a privileged Entra ID role", "High", "Persistence, PrivilegeEscalation",
    "PA-002", "New secret or certificate added to an application or service principal", "Medium", "Persistence, PrivilegeEscalation",
    "PA-003", "High-privilege permission granted to an application", "High", "Persistence, PrivilegeEscalation, CredentialAccess",
    "PA-004", "Conditional Access policy disabled, changed or deleted", "Medium", "DefenseEvasion, Persistence"
];
let AlertCounts = SecurityAlert
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
    | summarize AlertCount = count(), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by AlertName;
Rules
| join kind=leftouter AlertCounts on AlertName
| project RuleId, Rule = AlertName, Severity = RuleSeverity, Tactics, Alerts = coalesce(AlertCount, 0), LastAlert
| order by RuleId asc
content.title: Rule coverage
content.noDataMessage: No rules are defined for this area.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Account added to a privileged Entra ID role", "New secret or certificate added to an application or service principal", "High-privilege permission granted to an application", "Conditional Access policy disabled, changed or deleted"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
| summarize Alerts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), AlertName
content.title: Alerts over time, by rule
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Account added to a privileged Entra ID role", "New secret or certificate added to an application or service principal", "High-privilege permission granted to an application", "Conditional Access policy disabled, changed or deleted"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| project TimeGenerated, Rule = AlertName, Severity = AlertSeverity, Status,
          Details = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]), Entities
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Latest alerts
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Account added to a privileged Entra ID role", "New secret or certificate added to an application or service principal", "High-privilege permission granted to an application", "Conditional Access policy disabled, changed or deleted"]);
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Title in (RuleNames)
| extend LabelText = tostring(Labels)
| project CreatedTime, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Classification,
          AssignedTo = tostring(Owner.assignedTo),
          AgentDisposition = extract(@"soc-agent:(page|queue|auto_close|pending)", 1, LabelText), IncidentUrl
| order by CreatedTime desc
| take 250
content.title: Incidents created by these rules
content.noDataMessage: No incidents from these rules in the time range.
